name: Settlements, P&L and ticket counts
description: Settle a show from its actual sales, after Opendate's settlements: each act's deal worked through, deposits, adjustments with reasons, the venue in promoter mode, finalize (frozen) and reopen, a PDF. Profit and loss per show and across shows in forecast, estimate and actual columns, with CSV export. Scheduled ticket-count emails to agents. Money is in cents. Reads need `finance:read`, writes `finance:write`.

endpoints.description: The settlement row, its inputs and the computed result. Live until finalized: Exos ticket sales (tickets still valid, paid vs comps, gross less refunds; tax, fees and the ticketing fee as deductions), tickets sold elsewhere in the show's currency, finance items, the accepted offers on the show (or on its hold) and their pool, and the hold's rental terms. In promoter mode (a rented or partner venue, or a hold with rental terms) the venue is settled too: rental + its share of net box office − the rental deposit paid. The first read adds the rental line. Also /confirms/:id/settlements/summary.
